input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

This scene:
然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一些植物吃真好：真好吃
- 一些植物毒得很：毒性强得很

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一些植物吃真好：一些植物吃起来很好，The verb phrase needs the complement 起来 to describe how something tastes when eaten. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 毒得很：有毒，毒 is a noun and cannot take the degree complement 得很; use 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant. [teacher rule: du_youdu]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：他，The character was named in the immediately preceding scene and no other person competes as the referent, so use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 比方说他吃过：比方说吃过，After the subject has already been stated in the same sentence, use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: none]

items.reason: “吃真好”语序不对；“吃起来很好”是正确的说法。
“毒”不能直接带程度补语“得很”，用“有毒”正确。
神农刚在前文出现，按老师的指代规则这里应使用“他”。
同一句中主语已出现，后面的“他”应省略，但所示改后文字缺少宾语而不完整。
